data_policy: Train-aug only (6.2 training data, incl. its real Train reports). Challenge Sets, Validation and Test were not read.
presence_policy: Presence logic is unchanged from v1.1 (a report that never mentions a liver lesion stays unknown, not 0); the rules only touch count, segments, size and attenuation.

dropped_rules.reason: no Train-aug item needed it (ablation changed nothing)

rules.description: An elliptical clause that continues a lesion statement is part of it ("The largest, in segment 6, measures ...", "; size 8.2 x 6.8 cm").
rules.evidence_text: Seven hypoattenuating lesions are present in the liver. The largest, in segment 6, measures 6.3 x 3.3 cm.
The liver shows hypoattenuating lesions, 6 in total; the largest lies in segment 1 with a size of 4.1 x 3.6 cm.

rules.description: A labelled list ("Lesion 1: ... Lesion 2: ...") is counted by its highest label.
rules.evidence_text: Lesion 1: segment 3, 0.9 x 0.7 cm, hyperattenuating. Lesion 2: segment 6, 2.9 x 2.5 cm, hypoattenuating. Lesion 3: segments 2/8, 6.1 x 5.4 cm, hypoattenuating. Lesion 4: segment 6, 4.5 x 3.6 cm, hypoattenuating. Lesion 5: segment 4, 2.5 x 2.1 cm, hyperattenuating.

rules.description: A number followed by ".<digit>" after a segment list is a size, not a segment.
rules.evidence_text: Lesion 1: segment 3, 0.9 x 0.7 cm, hyperattenuating. Lesion 2: segment 6, 2.9 x 2.5 cm, hypoattenuating. Lesion 3: segments 2/8, 6.1 x 5.4 cm, hypoattenuating. Lesion 4: segment 6, 4.5 x 3.6 cm, hypoattenuating. Lesion 5: segment 4, 2.5 x 2.1 cm, hyperattenuating.

rules.description: "Another lesion" and "A further lesion" each add one lesion.
rules.evidence_text: One hypoattenuating lesion is present in segment 6 (4.0 x 3.0 cm). Another lesion is present in segment 1 (2.0 x 1.0 cm). A further lesion is present in segment 4 (1.5 x 0.9 cm).
A hypoattenuating lesion of 3.6 x 2.0 cm is present in subsegment IVa.

rules.description: Ordinal and word segment names ("the second segment", "segment eight").
rules.evidence_text: An isoattenuating lesion of 8.7 x 6.1 cm is present in the second segment of the liver.

rules.description: "segments 2 to 3" is a range of segments.
rules.evidence_text: A hypoattenuating lesion of 2.6 x 1.7 cm is present spanning segments 2 to 3.
A lesion of equal density is present in segment 6, with a size of 3.4 x 2.3 cm.

rules.description: Comparisons with the liver: "darker/less dense than", "brighter/denser than", "as dense as", "indistinguishable in density".
rules.evidence_text: In segment 5 there is a 3.8 x 2.5 cm lesion, brighter than the adjacent hepatic tissue.

rules.description: A sentence about the previous lesion's attenuation ("It appears hyperattenuating.", "Its attenuation is low.").
rules.evidence_text: There is a lesion in segments 3/6 with a size of 5.3 x 4.5 cm. It appears hyperattenuating.
Segments 4/5 contains a hyperdense focus of 4.9 x 2.7 cm.

rules.description: A bare plural with no unquantified word ("lesions are seen in segment 1 (1.3 x 1.1 cm) and ...") is counted from the sizes it lists.
rules.evidence_text: Hypoattenuating lesions are seen in segment 1 (1.3 x 1.1 cm) and segments 3/6 (2.3 x 1.6 cm).

rules.description: "the larger of the two" states two lesions.
rules.evidence_text: An isoattenuating lesion of 3.3 x 2.6 cm lies in segment 8. The larger of the two, hyperattenuating, lies in segment 4 with a size of 5.8 x 3.7 cm.
